title: Pulpo request (version 1)
description: One request of a Pulpo collection, stored as <order>-<name>.pulpo.yaml. The body lives next to it in <order>-<name>.body.<ext>.

name.description: Name shown in the collection tree.

protocol.description: Protocol used to send the request.

method.description: HTTP method. Required when protocol is http.

url.description: Target URL with the enabled query params. May contain {{variables}} and :pathParams.

pathParams.description: Values for the :name segments of the URL path. Values may contain {{variables}}.

disabledParams.description: Query params kept but not sent (not part of url).

enabled.description: Disabled headers are kept but not sent.

body.description: json/xml/html/javascript/graphql/text: the body is the file next to this one (.body.json, .body.xml, .body.html, .body.js, .body.graphql or .body.txt), chosen from the Content-Type header. urlencoded/multipart: the fields in form. file: the workspace file in bodyFile.

form.description: Fields of a urlencoded or multipart body. Values may contain {{variables}}.

file.description: Multipart only: a file to upload, relative to the workspace (it cannot leave it).

bodyFile.description: With body: file. A workspace file sent as the whole body, e.g. files/photo.png.

cookies.description: Send and store cookies with the environment's jar (.pulpo/cookies.json). A Cookie header written by hand wins.

settings.description: How the request is sent. Unset fields come from the nearest folder (_folder.yaml), then the workspace (pulpo.yaml), which take the same block.

verifySsl.description: False accepts invalid or self-signed server certificates.

proxy.description: system (HTTP_PROXY and friends, the default), none, or a proxy URL (http://, https://, socks5://). Credentials as {{variables}}.

timeoutMs.description: Old place of settings.timeoutMs; pulpo fmt moves it.

auth.description: How the request authenticates. Missing = inherit from the folder (_folder.yaml) or workspace (pulpo.yaml), which use the same block. Use {{variables}} for secrets.
